title: Member week horizon v1
description: Standalone measured week target. The consumer additionally checks the exact current member-week records and at least two settled weekly groups.

within_week_correlation.description: Measured within-week dependence from the same artifact and records as the target. Required as measurement evidence; never defaulted to zero or calculated by the browser.

member_week_keys.description: Exact current entry:gameweek:advice_sha256:outcome_snapshot_id record keys, compared as a set. At least two different settled weeks are checked by the consumer.
